correctness.rationale: Rechecked each original forth-up and forth-down quantifier for root-to-leaf comparisons. For target leaf u in R(root), every leaf successor row must include u; if root itself is a successor, each row is nonempty; the converse forth-down clause forces equality to U in the root-absent case. These conditions give three exhaustive disjoint forms. Independent direct 2^((m+1)^2) binary relation enumeration and S_m canonicalization produced (labelled,orbits) (7,7),(89,50),(5119,940) for m=1,2,3. Independently computed Burnside formula produced (89,50),(5119,940),(1211297,53170),(1171027327,9968880),(4624635403649,6472894706) for m=2..6. The all-m proof follows from row normal form and S_m cycle-fixed row counts, not the finite checks.
